name: Tökisy
notes: Early Age of Machinery, around or shortly after Year 2,200. Tökisy represents Nilgiri herding communities as freight routes and state surveys threaten seasonal crossings. Her programme links protected buffalo routes and shared watering access to the jurisdiction of pasture councils. The University register proposes a connection to Nilgiri Freight Route Hearing and Vijayan High Pasture Treaty. The capacity and timing depend on the event testimony.
sources: Author’s revised Early Age of Machinery placement and political roles, 2026-11-24.
